kvcc design system

Arc-based tokens, rules and components. Everything below renders from the real token file, so change the theme or accent and the whole page follows.

Apply this system

Instructions for anyone, human or model, designing a screen with kvcc. The exact token values are printed below as text, so copy them instead of approximating.

  1. 1. Paste the token CSS as isUse the variable names and values from the token reference below. Do not invent your own variables or pick colors by eye. Every color, radius, space, shadow and font comes from a token.
  2. 2. Type only from the scaleSizes are 12, 14, 16, 18, 22, 28, 36, 52 and 72px (--text-xs to --text-5xl). Body text is 14 or 16px, never 15 or 13. Weights 400 and 500 only. Geist for headings of 30px and up, Inter for everything else.
  3. 3. Primary buttonBackground --foreground, text --background, radius --radius-control (18px), height 44px, weight 500. Secondary: --surface with a 1px --border. Ghost: transparent, --text-secondary. One primary per screen, and it is the main action (Save changes, not Discard). The accent is not a button fill.
  4. 4. FieldsVisible label above, 44px tall, 18px radius, 1px --border-strong, background --surface. Focus is the border going to --foreground.
  5. 5. Switch and checkboxUse --control-on for the on track, --control-track for off, --control-thumb and --control-thumb-on for the thumb, --control-glyph for a check. Track 42 by 24px, thumb 18px. Never --accent for these.
  6. 6. SurfacesPanels are --surface with a 1px --border and --radius-panel (26px), no shadow. Shadow (--shadow-floating) only on floating layers: menus, dialogs, a sticky save bar.
  7. 7. AccentUse --accent for the active nav item, selected rows, links and small cues only. Active nav item: --accent-subtle background with --accent-strong text.
  8. 8. Keyboard and motionVisible focus on every control using the shared outline in the token CSS. Every transition has a prefers-reduced-motion branch. State changes (switch, drawer) never overshoot.
  9. 9. CopySentence case, no em dashes, verb plus object on buttons, label sample data as sample data.
  10. 10. PhonesControls 44px tall, 16px gutters, one column, no sideways scroll. Navigation is a drawer or a bottom bar with 44px targets.

:focus:not(:focus-visible),
:is(input:not([type="button"], [type="checkbox"], [type="color"], [type="file"], [type="image"], [type="radio"], [type="range"], [type="reset"], [type="submit"]), textarea, [contenteditable]:not([contenteditable="false"]), [role="menuitem"], [role="menuitemcheckbox"], [role="menuitemradio"], [role="option"], [tabindex="-1"]):focus { outline: none !important; }
:focus-visible:not(input:not([type="button"], [type="checkbox"], [type="color"], [type="file"], [type="image"], [type="radio"], [type="range"], [type="reset"], [type="submit"]), textarea, [contenteditable]:not([contenteditable="false"]), [role="menuitem"], [role="menuitemcheckbox"], [role="menuitemradio"], [role="option"], [tabindex="-1"]) {
  outline: var(--focus-outline-width, 2px) solid var(--focus-outline, color-mix(in oklab, var(--accent-strong) 72%, transparent)) !important;
  outline-offset: var(--focus-outline-offset, 2px) !important;
}

Rules that carry the look

Most of the visual language is a handful of constraints. Hold these and almost any layout reads as the same system.

  • Semantic color roles onlyNever raw hex or the neutral ramp in product code. One accent per screen, mostly neutral.
  • Three radiiControls 18px, panels 26px, surfaces 34px. Nested radius is outer minus padding.
  • Geist at 30px and up, Inter belowWeights 400 and 500 only. Sentence case everywhere, no uppercase labels.
  • Borders over shadowsCards rest on a hairline. Shadow is for floating layers: menus, popovers, dialogs.
  • State never overshootsSwitches, drawers and progress settle without bounce. Springs for movement, color for press feedback on anchors.
  • One focus ringA shared outline for keyboard focus only. No hand-written rings. Honor reduced motion everywhere.
  • Copy is part of the systemVerb plus object on buttons, no em dashes, errors say how to fix it, sample data is labeled.
  • 4px grid16px inside a group, 24px between regions, 44px default control height.
